notes.title: Nerfed Slimey
notes.notes:
[u]Slimey got nerf [/u]
[olist]
[*] Removed combo attacks
[*] Remove charge shots.
[*] Removed super Jump.
[/olist]
[u]All of Slimey's attacks and movements have an added delay.[/u]
[/olist]
[olist]
[*] Platform 1sec delay.
[*] Shield .75sec delay.
[*] Shooting .5 delay.
[*] Attack 1sec delay.
[/olist]

[u]Added a Public Or NonPublic Server Button[/u]


[i]This change will significantly help servers work more smoothly with clients. The removed portions will be modified and added back into the game shortly.[/i]
